verdict: No P0/P1/P2 semantic counterexample identified in the proposed two-clock decision rules, under the existing single synchronous main-loop call order. Await implementation review and native measurements.
important_callsite: Only after normal Render branch time_present returns. Includes Unchanged. Excludes image/MSX, owned deferral, Idle/Wait and exceptions.
existing_behavior_limit: When pending is only Background but ready input arrives after this loop read, the next frame may still render by start cadence; this intentionally preserves existing behavior. The improvement begins after an Input request has been made.
state_invariant: Completed belongs to the most recent Started; clearing it on every Render attempt prevents cross-frame reuse. A private closed variant Started/Completed(started,completed) or an outer option containing a mandatory Started plus optional Completed can express this without an impossible completed-only state.
